{{Quote|I understand that you were promised some rest and recreation time while you were here on the Donn, but we have just received a top priority assignment for you.|Commander Zeke Rondel, to a team of Rebel Alliance agents|<ref name="Abduction" />}}
'''Berrol's Donn''', also known as '''the Donn''', was a celestial body located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]], on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]]. It was situated outside the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and eventually it served as the site of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Berrol's Donn Rebel base|base]]. It also featured a [[City/Legends|town]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], and a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] called [[Sangorn's Net]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the crew of the Rebel [[VR-10 Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-class spacetug|spacetug]] ''[[Worthless Fool]]'' was dispatched from the Berrol's Donn base on a mission to find and retrieve the [[F7V Valet/Translator Droid|valet/translator droid]] [[KL-6TLF7V/T]], who knew the facility's location and had been [[Operation 45RA|kidnapped]] by forces affiliated with the Empire.

==Description==
Berrol's Donn, also referred to as the Donn, was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="Abduction" /> located in the [[Berrol's Donn system/Legends|Berrol's Donn system]], a part of the [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]]<ref name="EAOC Berrol" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA Berrol" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Berrol" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], which linked it to the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector's]] [[Togominda system/Legends|Togominda system]] as well as the [[Sil'Lume system/Legends|Sil'Lume system]]<ref name="TEA Berrol" /> of the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> In addition, Berrol's Donn was located at a distance of six [[Standard hour/Legends|hours']] travel&mdash;using a Class 2 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]&mdash;from the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Najarka]].<ref name="Abduction" />

==History==
===Republic and Empire===
[[File:Javin_Oversector.jpg|thumb|left|300px|During the Clone Wars, Berrol's Donn was located in the area of operations of the Galactic Republic's Nineteenth Sector Army.]]
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Berrol's Donn was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. Although, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Berrol's Donn was situated outside of the territory controlled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TEA Berrol" /> the Republic's [[Nineteenth Army|Nineteenth Sector Army]] was nevertheless tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of its enemy, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], in the celestial body's vicinity during the first campaigns of the Clone Wars in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Berrol's Donn system/Legends|Berrol's Donn system]]</ref> Berrol's Donn remained outside of the borders of the Republic's successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained on Berrol's Donn a [[Berrol's Donn Rebel base|base]] led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zeke Rondel]].<ref name="Abduction" /> The [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] member [[Fulkrehm Protial]] served at the facility, with Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] noting Berrol's Donn as Protial's current location at some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in an entry dedicated to the agent that was part of a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] detailing various Rebel operatives.<ref name="CRO" />

[[File:FulkrehmProtial-CRO.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rebel Alliance Intelligence operative Fulkrehm Protial served on Berrol's Donn.]]
The Berrol's Donn base was also home to a group of [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who once visited a nearby [[City/Legends|town]] and became intoxicated there. Protial, who noted the behavior of the returning pilots and who had himself suffered in [[Attack on Kostra|combat]] irreparable damage to his motor control skills that rendered his movements and speech outwardly similar to those of an [[Alcohol/Legends|inebriated]] person, eventually put into motion an operation in which he [[Spy/Legends|eavesdropped]] on the conversations of criminals at the local [[Sangorn's Net]] [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] while pretending to be drunk. Later, he expanded the operation to [[Foodstuff/Legends|drinking]] establishments throughout the Kriz [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="CRO" />

{{RPGseed}}
A group of individuals visited a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on Berrol's Donn at one point during the Galactic Civil War, with a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] also entering the venue at the same time. Upon noticing the group and consulting a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], however, the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]], not taking a seat, instead slowly walked back out of the restaurant.<ref name="Handbook" />
{{Endgame}}

===Trouble in the Rayter sector===
{{Quote|This agent is also important to our cause, for Alliance Intell has informed us that he is aware of the location of this base. If he breaks under Imperial interrogation, this base will be lost.|Commander Zeke Rondel, on the Rebel Alliance agent embedded in Crying Dawn Singer's entourage|<ref name="Abduction" />}}
[[File:6tl.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The knowledge possessed by KL-6TLF7V/T (pictured) endangered the Rebel Alliance base on Berrol's Donn.]]
As part of ongoing negotiations between the Alliance and the [[Shashay]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of<ref name="Abduction" /> the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC Crytal">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Crytal Nest system/Legends|Crytal Nest system]]</ref> planet [[Crytal Nest]], the Alliance added the [[F7V Valet/Translator Droid|valet/translator droid]] [[KL-6TLF7V/T]], who knew the location of the Berrol's Donn base, to the entourage of the Shashay [[Musician/Legends|performer]] [[Crying Dawn Singer]]. Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, [[Chief Administrator/Legends|Chief Administrator]] [[Braig Farool]] of [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]] and his brother [[Nak Farool|Nak]], [[Special Assistant]] to Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nile Owen]] of the Rayter sector, put into motion a [[Operation 45RA|plan]] to discredit the Alliance by kidnapping Crying Dawn Singer and his entourage. In addition to that event endangering the negotiations between the Alliance and the Shashay, Alliance Intelligence also informed the Rebel base on Berrol's Donn that KL-6TLF7V/T's knowledge put its location at risk of discovery by the Empire.<ref name="Abduction" />

The ''[[Worthless Fool]]'', a [[VR-10 Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-class spacetug|spacetug]] that was making regular supply runs to the base on Berrol's Donn, at that point had completed a run to that facility, with its crew of Rebel agents looking forward to a period of rest and recreation that they had been promised at the base. However, before they even left their [[Spacetug|ship]], the Rebel team was delivered a package from Rondel with a [[Dataplaque/Legends|data plaque]] and a [[directional transceiver]] inside it. The data plaque contained a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] message from the commander assigning the team to immediately travel to Najarka in order to locate and retrieve KL-6TLF7V/T, the signal from whose [[homing transponder]] could be tracked by the transceiver. After receiving the orders, the ''Worthless Fool'' rapidly departed the Berrol's Donn base and left for the [[Najarka system/Legends|Najarka system]].<ref name="Abduction" />

==Inhabitants==
The population of the Berrol's Donn [[Star system/Legends|system]] around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between ten and one hundred million.<ref name="TEA Berrol" />

==Locations==
During the Galactic Civil War, Berrol's Donn was the site of a Rebel Alliance base. The facility's personnel included [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and members of other species.<ref name="Abduction" /> The celestial body additionally hosted a town in which intoxicating substances could be acquired;<ref name="CRO" /> a restaurant;<ref name="Handbook" /> and a bar called Sangorn's Net that was frequented by criminals.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Publication history===
[[File:The_Abduction.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Berrol's Donn was introduced as a setting in ''The Abduction''.]]
Berrol's Doon first appeared in ''[[The Abduction]]'', a [[1992]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure authored by [[Chuck Truett]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Abduction" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Berrol's Donn system, and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square K-19.<ref name="TEA Berrol" /> The [[1993]] ''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'' sourcebook ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook]]'' mentioned Berrol's Donn in an example gameplay passage that illustrated the possible use of relatively generic characters controlled by the gamemaster player. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="Handbook" />

In ''The Abduction'', the second of the adventure's six episodes sees the player characters&mdash;barring their deaths or capture by the Galactic Empire&mdash;eventually depart the planet Najarka after locating KL-6TLF7V/T. Depending on whether they took the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with them, the adventure suggests several ways the scenario unfolds in order to connect with the subsequent episodes.<ref name="Abduction" />

In the adventure's first episode, the player characters can successfully learn from KL-6TLF7V/T that Crying Dawn Singer has been taken to the [[Laim system/Legends|Laim system]], which the group can then travel to. This article assumes this outcome as being [[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Abduction" />

===Alternate events===
{{Quote|That Droid you left behind was an agent of the Alliance. It had the locations ''[sic]'' of this base in its memory, and the Force knows what else!|Commander Zeke Rondel, to a team of Rebel Alliance agents on Berrol's Donn in an alternate branch of events of ''The Abduction''|<ref name="Abduction" />}}
[[File:II-xC.jpg|thumb|left|300px|In ''The Abduction'', the player characters can potentially be directed to travel from Berrol's Donn to the Laim system (pictured).]]
Alternatively, if the player characters do not learn this information and, as a result, are not certain of their next move, ''The Abduction'' suggests that their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''Worthless Fool'', returns to the Rebel Alliance base on Berrol's Donn&mdash;noting that the ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Maytoc Kollene]], would only take them there anyway. At the base, Alliance droid [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] extract the information from KL-6TLF7V/T and Commander Zeke Rondel then directs the player characters to the Laim system.<ref name="Abduction" />

If the player characters do not retrieve KL-6TLF7V/T from Najarka, however, the droid is captured by the Empire, allowing it to learn the location of the Berrol's Donn base. The ''Worthless Fool'' returns to the base amid frantic evacuation, and the player characters are confronted by Rondel, who is angered over the failure of their mission. The commander then informs the group that the Alliance has traced the holotransmission implicating the Rebellion in Crying Dawn Singer's kidnapping&mdash;one that the player characters witness in the adventure's first episode&mdash;to a [[Subspace relay station/Legends|subspace relay station]] in the Laim system. As the group then departs aboard the ''Worthless Fool'', several [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]] arrive in the Berrol's Donn system and a battle begins against the Rebel forces of the base.<ref name="Abduction" />
